text: ājānāsi . rūpañce bhikkhu anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . vedanañce . saññañce . saṅkhāre ce . viññāṇañce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . rūpañce bhikkhu nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . vedanañce . saññañce . saṅkhāre ce . viññāṇañce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti . [76] atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā
